Description: Vibration multiple of a component's own baseline at which an alert is raised. Set to the LOWEST threshold at which rotor-assembly precision reaches its 75 percent target -- the operating point a programme tuning for trustworthy alerts would actually choose. Lowering it buys lead time and loses precision; that trade-off is the point.
Maintenance capacity available to the fleet per week. Changing it re-cuts the action queue, which is how the question "what if we add a bay" gets answered without editing anything.
The date every as-of figure is computed at. Pinned rather than derived from the data so a published number stays reproducible after the next load.

Window for rate metrics such as unscheduled removals. Since-inception rates improve every month for reasons unrelated to maintenance, because early in a fleet life nothing has reached its first interval yet.
